text:
We launched SILT three weeks ago, in what turned out to be a tough month for supplements in India.

In late October, ASCI reported that 60 of the 61 nutraceutical ads it reviewed broke the advertising code. In mid November, FSSAI acted against six supplement makers over safety and labelling. For a brand this new, that's a useful mirror.

So here is where we stand. Before launch, 1,870 people pre-booked. In the first 15 days, 250 people bought SILT and 10 had already reordered. Verified reviews average 4.9 out of 5.

What we checked again this month: every dose is printed on both packs, there are no proprietary blends, and each of our 19 ingredients has a lab report, with 293 checks and none failed. We don't use melatonin, added sugar or maltodextrin, and our ashwagandha is a root extract.

One thing we'd change is delivery. An early order bounced between courier hubs for days, and it reminded us that trust is built after checkout too.

If you're building in health or food, what did your first month teach you?

#preventivehealth #D2CIndia
